newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundupp - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundupp - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow late Tuesday. There were not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test at the close.
Inquiry was moderate, demand was light. Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers and no slaughter heifers. For the week to date on 7,600 head mostly previously contracted or formalated cattle.
Steers - few select and choice 2-3 1200 lbs Holsteins 60.00.
confirmed: 100 last week: 54300 last year: none
week to date: 7600 last week: 59600 last year: 8200
